caption: The drawing features a black or dark gray cylindrical mug with a slightly flared rim and base, depicted in three-quarter view facing left. The mug has two narrow horizontal bands encircling its body—one near the top and another near the bottom. Attached to the right side of the mug is a large, ornately curved handle with a pronounced outward curl at its lower end, resembling a scroll. The mug is centered within a lightly drawn square indicating its frame or intended area. In the upper left corner of the drawing is a detailed line sketch of the handle in both profile and side views, annotated with dimensions for height and width. In the lower right corner, there is a simple line diagram of the mug’s elevation with measurements, showing its width at the top and bottom. The drawing is rendered on a light tan or off-white background paper, which shows some slight discoloration or spotting in the margins. The artist's signature, "Eugene F. Barrell," is written below the main drawing in small script.
title: Pewter Mug
